summary: CDT Environmental Technology Investment Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 7, 2026, attaching a press release announcing it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 per share. The company received a notice from Nasdaq on June 30, 2026, after its closing bid price remained at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days. No price, premium, or deal terms were disclosed. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special-situation event. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring, or other extraordinary corporate action. The filing merely confirms the listing deficiency matter is closed.
